# Mahdi Salek — Front-End Developer

> Portfolio of Mahdi Salek, a front-end developer focused on Vue.js, Nuxt, and building maintainable, production-ready web applications.

## Overview

Mahdi Salek builds feature-rich web applications with an emphasis on clean architecture, server-side rendering (SSR), performance, maintainability, accessibility, and production quality.

Primary areas of work include dashboards, admin tools, data-heavy interfaces, and product-focused web applications.

## Core Technologies

- Vue: https://vuejs.org/
- Nuxt: https://nuxt.com/
- Vuetify: https://vuetifyjs.com/
- TypeScript: https://www.typescriptlang.org/
- Pinia: https://pinia.vuejs.org/
- Nuxt i18n: https://i18n.nuxtjs.org/

Additional front-end technologies and practices include JavaScript, VueUse, Vue Router, HTML, CSS, Sass, responsive design, Material Design Icons, left-to-right and right-to-left layouts, and light/dark themes.

## Tooling

Git, GitHub Actions, Docker, npm, Bun, Webpack, ESLint, and Prettier.

## Selected Projects

### IDEX Platform

Website: https://idex.se/

A platform focused on safety, compliance, and creating safer work environments across industry, construction, and the public sector.

### Procycons

Website: https://procycons.com/

A project combining digital solutions with ecological sustainability and environmental protection.

## Professional Focus

- Server-side rendering (SSR)
